meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Morning. Sofia's on leave and Dr. Mehta is in theatre, so it's Ravi, Kiran, me, and Neha from marketing joining us today.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Neha
meeting_transcripts.content: Hi everyone, thanks for having me.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Welcome, Neha.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Ravi, launch status?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Good. The Andheri go-live on the fifteenth of March is confirmed again. The front desk finished testing yesterday.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Excellent. So the fifteenth of March stays.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Neha
meeting_transcripts.content: Can I ask about reminders? Our patient survey says almost everyone uses WhatsApp now.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: That's true. Even the older patients have it. Their children set it up for them.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: The WhatsApp business API is ready on our side. We could send the message the evening before.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Neha
meeting_transcripts.content: The evening before works best. People remember what they hear the night before.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay, patients get a WhatsApp message the evening before their appointment.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll set up the message template this week.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Payments. Ravi, you've been doing the integration?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Yes. The payment SDK we're integrating is PayU. Their card flow is quicker, fewer screens for the patient.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Fine with me, as long as patients can still pay at the desk.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Okay, card payments run on PayU.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: Another thing. A lot of follow-up visits are just "show me your reports". We could do those over video.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: Patients who live far away would love that.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Neha
meeting_transcripts.content: It would be a nice story for the launch, too.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's do it. We pilot video consultations for follow-up visits in version one.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll start on it after launch week.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: About cancellations by phone: we need to record that the patient agreed.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Ravi
meeting_transcripts.content: We can add a field where the staff note that the patient gave verbal consent.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Good. When the front desk cancels for a patient, they note the patient's verbal consent in the app.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Neha
meeting_transcripts.content: Will there be posters at the clinic for the launch?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kiran
meeting_transcripts.content: The Andheri manager would like that. The waiting room has space.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Neha
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll bring some designs next time.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Anita
meeting_transcripts.content: Thanks, everyone. Good meeting.
